displayName: Synthesized Bodyweight Squat Engineering Reference v1
purpose: Prove that PocketPT can compose a new exercise motion from reusable movement mechanics without downloading or copying a named squat animation.

evidence.caution: Sneaking style is not copied; only coarse low-stance mechanics are used.
Kettlebell swing styling and ballistic timing are not copied.
Jump takeoff velocity is not used; only symmetric loading/extension directionality informs the proof.
Impact/landing style is not copied; only controlled compression/recovery relationships inform the proof.

engineeringAssumptions: The first proof is intentionally symmetric left-to-right.
Root depth is expressed as a fraction of avatar height, not source FBX units.
Bone rotations are rest-relative engineering offsets intended for visual review, not anatomical ground truth.
The synthesized motion must not be used for scoring, coaching tolerances, medical claims, or biomechanical validation.
Front and side human MoveNet recordings will later be used to calibrate stance, knee tracking, torso angle, depth, timing, and phase boundaries.

acceptanceBoundary.candidateIf: The avatar visibly performs a coherent stand -> descend -> bottom -> rise -> stand cycle without using a downloaded squat animation.
